description: ignorePaths is emptied to override :ignoreModulesAndTests (via config:best-practices -> config:recommended), which skips test/*/scenarios.json. This drops all of its defaults (node_modules, vendor, examples, etc.), but none of them are used in this repository

customManagers.description: Base images in the baseImage matrix of the reusable test workflow (test-feature.yaml). Only entries that already carry a digest are matched, so add a new image with its digest
Images of the test scenarios. Only entries that already carry a digest are matched, so add a new image with its digest

The ShellCheck release archives that the shellcheck feature pins, one dependency per line of ARCHIVES in install.sh. The datasource finds the release asset that has the current digest and replaces it with the digest of the asset of the same name in the new release, so each line gets the digest of its own architecture
The ShellCheck version that the test of the shellcheck feature expects and that NOTES.md names. It has to change together with the archives in install.sh, or the test fails

packageRules.description: The tags of the test base images are the set of supported releases. Adding or dropping a release is a deliberate change, so Renovate only refreshes the digests
Refresh the digests of all test base images in one pull request a month. They must move together, because a scenario image has to be written exactly as it is in the baseImage matrix
The archives pinned in install.sh and the version the test expects go into one pull request, because either change alone fails CI
